newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Nov 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Nov 26.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Unions divided over whether truck drivers' conflict will spread to other sectors, while hauliers beging blocking roads and petrol depots in the Paris area.

-- Schneider considers a management buyout of construction subsidiary Spie Batignolles, part of which it hopes to sell to Britain's Amec. Profit-making electricity unit Spie Trindel would be bought by the workers' holding.

-- Alcatel Alsthom chairman considers new bid for Thomson if a planned sale to Lagardere Groupe does not close by December 31, according to a parliamentarian's report quoted earlier by daily Liberation.
-- Russian government considers gesture toward reimbursement of pre-1917 Russian bonds.
